text: 中国央行：初步统计，2026年2季度末，我国金融业机构总资产为562.2万亿元，同比增长7.7%，其中，银行业机构总资产为497.98万亿元，同比增长6.6%；证券业机构总资产为20.37万亿元，同比增长29.8%；保险业机构总资产为43.86万亿元，同比增长11.8%。
text_en: The People's Bank of China stated that, according to preliminary statistics, as of the end of Q2 2026, total assets of China's financial institutions stood at RMB 562.2 trillion, up 7.7% year on year. Of this, banking institutions' total assets were RMB 497.98 trillion, up 6.6%; securities institutions' total assets were RMB 20.37 trillion, up 29.8%; and insurance institutions' total assets were RMB 43.86 trillion, up 11.8%.
